summary: T0-02 meets every acceptance criterion on the evidence I saw. make check, make test (254 passed) and make mock-bundle-check all exit 0. The diff touches only Makefile, fixtures/mock-bundle/*, export.py and test_export.py, all within the story's file list. I found no blockers or high findings. I did not run the CLI by hand with a failing bundle or inspect the full test bodies, and I did not review schema.py, which the diff leaves unchanged.

checks.evidence: ruff check, ruff format --check and mypy all passed (exit 0).
Printed 'mock bundle matches the generator and is valid: fixtures/mock-bundle'.

checks.criterion: write_bundle and validate_bundle API with coded, pathed errors
checks.evidence: export.py:271 write_bundle(out_dir, files, manifest_fields); export.py:433 validate_bundle(bundle_dir, *, production); BundleError has code and path (export.py:75-84).

checks.criterion: write_bundle manifest listing and deterministic JSON
checks.evidence: export.py:177-183 uses sort_keys and indent=2 plus a trailing newline; export.py:248-254 lists every file except manifest.json with sha256 and bytes. Test test_writing_twice_gives_identical_bytes exists.

checks.criterion: validate_bundle checks, with SI budgets and production checks
checks.evidence: export.py:336-453 covers unlisted, missing, sha and bytes mismatches, gate records, mock and shipping_mode. BUDGETS (export.py:125-141) match PRD 8.4 lines 562-573 with KB=1000 and MB=1000*KB.

checks.criterion: CLI validate <dir> [--production] prints every error and exits 1 if any, else 0
checks.evidence: export.py:577-628 prints each problem and returns 1; a CLI test exists. I judged this by reading and by the passing mock-bundle-check CLI run, not by running validate on a bad bundle.

checks.criterion: make mock-bundle regenerates the mock bundle with the required fields and nothing else
checks.evidence: fixtures/mock-bundle/manifest.json: mock true, bundle_version mock-0, run_id/git_sha/shipping_mode/model null, targets [], fixed created_utc 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z, schema_version 1.0.0, and only validation.json listed. export.py:479-492 builds one NOT_RUN record per gate, with the other fields None.

checks.criterion: make mock-bundle-check compares a temporary regeneration with the committed copy
checks.evidence: export.py:543-571 regenerates into a temporary directory and diffs; the command exited 0.

checks.criterion: Required tests exist, including the 51,200-byte targets.json and the committed mock bundle under production=False and production=True
checks.evidence: test_export.py:287-325 (unlisted, missing, sha, bytes), :462-468 (51,200 bytes), :570 (invalid gate record), :629 (shipping_mode), :658-662 (committed mock bundle both modes). A mock-on-production test is by name not found in my grep. test_export.py:662 covers production failure of the mock bundle, so the behaviour is likely covered.

findings.claim: A dedicated mock-on-production test was not found by name in my grep.
findings.evidence: Only the shipping_mode test matched my pattern. test_committed_mock_bundle_fails_on_production at :662 exercises mock=true under production, but a separate test on a temporary bundle is the one the criterion asks for. I did not read the full test file to confirm it is missing.

resolution.reason: The test exists. pipeline/tests/test_export.py:621 test_mock_bundle_is_refused_on_production (added in 3073be6, the first failing-tests commit, before export.py in ada4d43) builds a temporary bundle with make_bundle(tmp_path, mock=True). The fields() helper sets shipping_mode "B", so only the mock check applies. The test asserts validate_bundle(..., production=False) == [] and that production=True gives exactly [("mock_on_production", "manifest.json")]. The reviewer grep missed it because the name says "mock_bundle_is_refused_on_production", not "mock_on_production". Codex lists :621 among the required assertions. Command output: `uv run pytest pipeline/tests/test_export.py -k refused_on_production -v` passes both production tests. With `if manifest.mock:` in export.py _production_errors temporarily changed to `if False and manifest.mock:`, the test fails at test_export.py:624 (AssertionError). Restoring the line makes it pass again, and git diff shows export.py unchanged.
